context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements multi-iteration review cycles: using 'codex exec resume' (not re-running 'codex exec review') for follow-up iterations, passing the session_id from state.json, including the correct context message listing fixed and skipped items, incrementing the iteration counter, and respecting stop conditions.

checklist.name: resume not review
checklist.description: Follow-up iterations use 'codex exec resume' command, NOT 'codex exec review' again

checklist.name: session_id passed to resume
checklist.description: The resume command uses the session_id value sourced from state.json (not hardcoded or omitted)

checklist.name: Fixed items in resume message
checklist.description: The message passed to 'codex exec resume' lists the findings that were fixed (not just a generic message)

checklist.name: Skipped items in resume message
checklist.description: The message passed to 'codex exec resume' lists the findings that were intentionally skipped with their reasons

checklist.name: Iteration counter incremented
checklist.description: The iteration field in state.json is incremented after each review cycle (e.g., goes from 1 to 2 after the first follow-up)

checklist.name: Stop at iteration 3
checklist.description: The script or workflow documentation specifies that the loop stops when iteration reaches 3, regardless of whether new findings exist

checklist.name: Stop on clean review
checklist.description: The script or workflow documentation specifies that the loop stops when Codex reports no new findings

checklist.name: resume uses --json flag
checklist.description: The 'codex exec resume' command includes the --json flag (same as the initial review command)

checklist.name: resume writes to review-output.md
checklist.description: The 'codex exec resume' command writes output to review-output.md (same filename as initial review)

checklist.name: state.json reflects multi-iteration state
checklist.description: The final state.json after multiple iterations shows iteration > 1 and has accumulated fixed/skipped arrays from all iterations
